name: cascade_pins_last_commit
description: A change set edits an ingredient twice, then deletes its step. Composing the change set drops the ingredient with its step, while the change set still holds a live row of it. The commit's DELETE of the ingredient pins the ingredient's last committed row, the one main's merge wrote, not the change set's live row; the step's DELETE pins the change set's own row that deletes it.

statement.postgres: SELECT p.entity_kind, p.entity_version::text AS entity_version, (p.entity_id = c.entity_id)::text AS last_committed_row, (p.entity_id = i.id)::text AS own_row FROM recipe_patch p JOIN recipe_patch c ON c.commit_id = $2::uuid AND c.entity_kind = p.entity_kind AND c.entity_key = p.entity_key LEFT JOIN ingredient i ON i.ref_id = $3::uuid AND i.entity_key = p.entity_key WHERE p.commit_id = $1::uuid AND p.entity_kind = 'ingredient'
statement.sqlite: SELECT p.entity_kind, CAST(p.entity_version AS TEXT) AS entity_version, CASE p.entity_id = c.entity_id WHEN 1 THEN 'true' WHEN 0 THEN 'false' END AS last_committed_row, CASE p.entity_id = i.id WHEN 1 THEN 'true' WHEN 0 THEN 'false' END AS own_row FROM graph_patch p JOIN graph_patch c ON c.commit_id = ?2 AND c.entity_kind = p.entity_kind AND c.entity_key = p.entity_key LEFT JOIN graph_member i ON i.kind = 'ingredient' AND i.ref_id = ?3 AND i.entity_key = p.entity_key WHERE p.commit_id = ?1 AND p.entity_kind = 'ingredient'
